title: Capacitance Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The capacitance C must be correctly calculated as C = 4 pi epsilon_0 b.

title: Energy Density Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The energy density w_e(r) must be expressed correctly as w_e(r) = Q^2 / (32 pi^2 epsilon_0 r^4).

title: Total Energy Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The total energy W_e must be derived correctly as W_e = Q^2 / (8 pi epsilon_0 b).

title: Work Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The work W must be calculated correctly as W = Q^2 / (8 pi epsilon_0 b).

title: Minimum Electric Field
description: Important Criteria: The radius a for minimum electric field must be determined correctly as a = b / 2.

title: Integration Steps
description: Optional Criteria: Clear and correct integration steps should be shown for calculating total energy and work.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units should be consistent throughout the calculations, especially for energy and capacitance.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the equations.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that final answers are clearly presented and match the required format.
